sampling_model.design: Population-level finite SCM identification from the full observed law with \(G,\Omega,W,\Pi,x,y\) supplied to the decision problem; no experimental randomization is assumed.
sampling_model.units: The identification statements compare all finite SCMs inducing the same observed distribution; sampling enters only after identification.
sampling_model.treatment: The intervention replaces the equations at \(X\) by the fixed assignment \(x\).
sampling_model.overlap: The novel input \(\Pi\) declares arbitrary positive or zero observed events. It is distinct from Chen--Darwiche Theorem 15's separability and parent conditions and from Theorem 18's treatment-marginal positivity set \(C_V=\{\Pr(X)>0:X\text{ is a treatment variable}\}\); only denominators executed on a support branch must be certified positive.
sampling_model.nuisance_estimation: Not part of the kernel; a multinomial plug-in estimator is available after a guarded formula is returned.

Theorems 1--2 prove soundness of formula-returning algorithms for state-based causal effects under context-specific independences and state-alphabet constraints; the paper assumes a strictly positive observational distribution and does not claim completeness under those constraints.

body.tldr: This note formulates, but does not construct, a bounded support-aware grammar for FID-S. The intended procedure concerns finite latent DAGs with supplied observed alphabets, qualitative functional nodes, and declared positive or zero observed events, and would return an inconsistency certificate, a guarded identifying formula, or an exact-support rational separating pair. The proved classical result is conditional and abstract: any restricted grammar instance satisfying the local seven-case interface reproduces ordinary ID; no such concrete FID-S grammar instance is constructed here. The fully observed completion frontier is proved: for each obstruction and each integer \(r\geq 3\), an existentially selected common-law fiber has target gap at least \(1-2/r\), primitive denominator at most \(r|V|\max_{i\in V}|\Omega_i|\), and the stated logarithmic primitive-bit bound. The case \(r=8\) gives the \(3/4\)-gap corollary, but no constant-gap claim is made for every fixed observational law on the same support. The supported-bow pattern is resolved directly by its proposition, thereby furnishing a mandatory regression instance for any future support trichotomy. The general support-preserving independent-source latent lift, rational equal-law witness theorem, converse formula reconstruction, concrete finite grammar, certificate syntax, and global search bounds remain open.

project_justification.gap: Ordinary hedge completeness ignores declared structural-zero faces. Chen--Darwiche Theorem 15 gives functional-variable elimination under stated separability and parent conditions, and Theorem 18 assumes the treatment-marginal positivity set \(C_V=\{\Pr(X)>0:X\text{ is a treatment variable}\}\); neither theorem identifies the arbitrary declared zero-and-positive support-literal regime introduced here. Chen--Darwiche's 2026 Theorems 1--2 are sound formula-returning algorithms for state-based effects under context-specific independences and state-alphabet constraints with a strictly positive observational law, not a complete formula-or-exact-support-countermodel procedure for valid intervention states on structural-zero faces. Kivva, Mokhtarian, Etesami, and Kiyavash prove sound-and-complete gID under positivity of the observational law, not on arbitrary declared support faces, and do not supply exact-support rational paired witnesses. Tikka--Hyttinen--Karvanen Theorem 5 supplies a terminating sound CSI search, and Theorem 6 shows why contextwise answers do not give completeness.
project_justification.niche: Finite categorical latent SCMs with explicit observed alphabets admit combinatorial support certificates and canonical response coordinates, but existing tools do not coordinate them with query-specific hedge traces, exact witness lifting that preserves the latent-source architecture of \(G\), and auditable rational serialization.
project_justification.fill: If the latent-lifting OEQ is resolved, the resulting FID-S procedure will preserve \(\Omega\), exact support, functional-row provenance, and the latent-source architecture and will return the stated three certificate types. What is proved now is only the universal conditional compiler theorem for an abstract instance satisfying the local classical-ID interface. Separately, the fully observed frontier has a parameterized rational smoothing certificate: for every integer \(r\geq3\), each completion obstruction admits an existentially chosen same-law exact-support pair with gap at least \(1-2/r\) and primitive bit cost growing as \(O(\log r)\); this does not construct or settle the latent grammar.

body.related_work: Shpitser and Pearl supply the recursive seven-case ID algorithm, its soundness and completeness results, and the hedge results with their proper failed-subquery and existential original-query scopes. The only containment established in this note is the conditional full-support, \(W=\varnothing\) embedding of classical ID: every abstract restricted grammar satisfying the local seven-case interface has the same call tree and normalized successful expression, but no concrete FID-S instance of that interface is constructed. The comparison papers do not supply the complete exact-support rational-countermodel trichotomy requested by the latent-lifting OEQ, and this note does not yet supply it either. Chen--Darwiche's functional-elimination, treatment-positivity, constrained-identifiability, and strictly positive state-based results are used only for theorem-specific premise separations or informed-by comparisons; they do not establish a global inclusion between their regimes and the arbitrary support-literal regime here. The same is true of the cited context-specific, generalized-identification, possibilistic-compatibility, latent-cardinality, and response-coordinate results: they provide non-subsumption facts, uncovered residual regimes, or ingredients, not global class inclusions. The supported-bow pattern is resolved directly by the dedicated proposition, thereby furnishing a mandatory regression instance for any future support trichotomy. The support-preserving independent-source rational lift remains explicitly open.
body.technical_internal_limitation: The fully observed completion argument does not survive marginalization: equality of observed laws becomes a system of polynomial equalities in products of latent-source probabilities, so a local target-varying direction need not factor into independent sources, and a real separating fiber need not contain a rational point. The current trace and algorithm definitions are handles rather than a concrete production system. The abstract seven-case compiler theorem is proved, but it cannot be instantiated for the proposed procedure until the latent-lifting question constructs the required transition relation, compiler, state embedding, and provenance map. These construction and lifting tasks remain open obligations, not assumptions used by the abstract theorem.
body.honest_scope: The following are proved: the finite support oracle; the fully observed completion frontier and guarded identifying formula; for every integer \(r\geq3\), the fully observed existential-fiber smoothing certificate with gap at least \(1-2/r\), denominator bound \(r|V|\max_{i\in V}|\Omega_i|\), and logarithmic primitive-bit cost; the supported-bow formula and exact rational separating pair; and the universally quantified conditional classical-ID compiler theorem for every abstract grammar instance satisfying the local seven-case interface. The following are not constructed or proved: a concrete FID-S grammar or compiler satisfying that interface; the general support-preserving independent-source latent lift; a general rational equal-law witness theorem; converse guarded-formula reconstruction in the latent case; terminal-certificate syntax; the kill-instance audit against concrete productions; and explicit global search, latent-cardinality, and certificate-bit bounds. The parameterized constant gap is existentially obtained by choosing a fully observed observational fiber for each completion obstruction and is not asserted for every fixed law with that support. A failure pair is scoped to its actual failed query or subquery, and only the published existential-subquery hedge conclusion is carried back to the original query. Generic real quantifier elimination, unrestricted latent flattening, and the fully observed special case do not resolve the latent headline.
